stock.description: ClouDr Group Limited operates as an investment holding company, providing a diverse range of services within the healthcare sector. The firm supplies hospitals and pharmacies with crucial medical products, including devices like blood glucose meters and vital sign monitors, glucose testing strips, and both over-the-counter and prescription drugs. In addition to physical goods, ClouDr delivers software-as-a-service (SaaS) platforms tailored for healthcare facilities and pharmacies, while also offering digital marketing solutions to pharmaceutical companies. Furthermore, the company facilitates the management of chronic conditions through real-time online consultations, digital health monitoring, and remote prescription and ordering services. Established in 2014, ClouDr Group Limited maintains its primary corporate office in Hangzhou, China.
